item: The forced re-check list loads only the sources a pass can use; the boot step guards the stored shape (diagnostics rank 14, from the coordinator's check of #1285)
status: SHIPPED (field effect at each instance's next pass)
summary: pending_forced reads (id, status, newest verdict) for every flagged entry and loads only the Source rows a pass can use, still counting every entry; the boot step leaves a stored list of a shape it did not write as it is. Three pins added: a measured verdict never changes at the boot step, the spare-slot fill never takes a source twice when the list is longer than its share, and the slice. OPEN_QUEUE states the list's size, its blind spot (import versus local inversions) and that the whole stored list is still rewritten after a pass. Each fix has a test that fails when it is removed.
